verseText: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.
meaning: God is so mighty, even his voice is powerful. When God speaks, amazing things happen. God spoke to create the world and Jesus often spoke to do miracles.

recall.question: What is the voice of the LORD like?

application.prompt: When you read God's words, remember the powerful God who speaks them.
